extraction.Name: James Sanovia
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his allotment of 320 acres, but was told by the Indian Agency that he would have to accept it, so he did
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold his allotment to a man by the name of White, of Gordon, Nebraska, for $3200.00, receiving cash
extraction.Buyer: a man by the name of White, of Gordon, Nebraska, for $3200.00
extraction.Occupation/Income: his source of income is through gardening and a little lease money that his wife gets off of her allotment
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health is poor, being ruptured; wife is frail; two minor children to support, children have good health; has never received any help from the County or Government; document sworn November 17, 1928
